policyGuide.title: Update policy guide
policyGuide.description: The three policies control whether execution sessions are retained and whether unchanged work is reused. Comparing them separately shows where a performance difference comes from.

static-full.description: Fully compiles and draws every update without retaining the Runtime or renderer session. This is the stable, direct full-update baseline.

retained-full.description: Retains the Runtime and renderer session but still forces a full update every time. This isolates the cost of the retained architecture itself.

retained-auto.description: Retains the Runtime and renderer session, uses snapshot diff and Scene Patch to reuse unchanged work, and falls back to a full update when needed.

compare.staticVsRetained: Observe the architectural cost of retaining the Runtime and renderer session.
compare.retainedFullVsAuto: Observe the benefit of automatic incremental updates and content reuse.
compare.staticVsAuto: Observe the end-to-end result of retained auto relative to the static baseline.
